event.calendar: Non-overlapping UTC clock hours with all expected chart bars present, start at first open and end at last close, after 250 chart bars and 24 earlier complete hours.
event.threshold: Absolute open-to-close displacement at least 1.5 times the median high-low range of the previous 24 complete hours and at least 0.60 times current high-low range.
event.measurement: Same-side watch, confirmation, geometry-ready intent and fill in the half-open hour. Report carry-in and opposite-side fills separately. Measure first fill excursion through the earlier of event end and final exit, ignoring unknown exit-bar extremes. Event labels are unavailable to admission.
event.false_positive_proxy: Count confirmations and fills outside registered same-side hours, with the associated actual outcome. The outcome-based event label may exclude successful trades and movements that cross the hour boundary.

signals.higher_timeframe_anchor: H1 UTC clock hours. H4 OANDA session buckets at New York local 01:00, 05:00, 09:00, 13:00, 18:00 and 21:00, verified against archive HTF close changes. Build EMA21/55 from prior closed aggregates with available earlier M30 chart prehistory. Verify archived confirmed HTF prices where exported and record warmup limits. Native comparison requires direct native HTF tape.

execution.primary_policy: Fixed bracket on independent A, B and C and then on combined ABC. Use the new Pine source defaults for signal constants, model-order priority and lifecycle.
execution.intrabar_model: Next observed open for a confirmed market decision. Attach frozen brackets at submission. The open handles existing stop or limit gaps. When both sides trade within the candle and the order is ambiguous, process the stop first. Adjusted protection becomes effective only on the next open. Keep unclosed positions censored.
execution.capital_model: Single USD account with one pending or open campaign. At each close process prior campaign settlement then reserve the slot and check available capital against three units of notional. Check actual gap notional at fill. Keep the slot until final exit bar close. The original S5 campaign tape preserves actual fills. Replay S5 alone to verify occupancy before using its frozen proposals in a combined portfolio.
execution.risk_policy_panel: ABC with fixed signals, defaults and input history. Evaluate cost-adjusted break-even after TP1, 0.05 actual-R lock after TP1, 2 ATR trailing, confirmed pivot trailing, 24-bar time exit and deterioration in separate runs. Re-run admission and occupancy for each variant. Comparisons are exploratory.

portfolio.priority: Chronological decisions. S5 first at a simultaneous decision in S5+ABC, then fixed native model priority. Check reverse engine priority as sensitivity. Original rejected/unobserved S5 proposals cannot enter a newly freed slot.
portfolio.metrics: Complete campaign outcomes, wins, losses, net USD, mean realized net R over valid initial risk, profit factor, campaign-close drawdown, worst losing streak, holding minutes and bars, observed market exposure, fees and cost stress. Log candidate rejects and opportunity cost of blocked known offers.
portfolio.acceptance_gates: Positive net and stressed USD delta versus matched S5, higher mean net R, no larger campaign-close drawdown, directional event capture improvement and no rise in off-event loss rate. Promotion requires independent untouched data and executable native evidence.

chronology.data_status: All inherited archives and November 10 are previously inspected development evidence. Genuine untouched holdout availability is unverified.
chronology.earlier_later_split: Fixed 60% by chart-bar index, retain wholly contained campaigns and hours. No fit or model choice on the later sample.
chronology.walk_forward: Freeze configuration once and step through expanding chronological train context into complete subsequent UTC weeks. Report the weekly outcome tape; training does not estimate or retune parameters. Omit straddling campaigns from weekly summaries and retain them in full-window totals.
chronology.multiple_comparisons: Primary M5 family A, B, C, ABC and S5+ABC against S5 using paired UTC day differences in stressed realized USD. One-sided fixed-seed block sign flip with five adjacent observed days per block, Holm correction across five. Test is descriptive on archived samples. M15/M30 and the seven management policies are robustness comparisons.
